name: Gnome Race
desc:
Welcome to the Gnome Race! 
Reach the finish line under 2 minutes and earn wins! 

New Updates At Saturdays! 
💡 How To Play:
- Click to go even faster 💥
- More Wins give more speed 🏆
- Finish More Races for more speed 💨
- Reach the END of the levels 🏁 
- Get in the Top 50 Leaderboards 🌍

PREMIUM PLAYERS GET +20% WINS & +10% ACCELRATION
